description: Unit test class for ImmutableLogEntry, testing creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and validation.

classes.name: ImmutableLogEntryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ImmutableLogEntry implementation.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null correlation ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullTimestamp
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null timestamp throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogCategory
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null category throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogType
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullMessage
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null message throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogLevel
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null log level throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullAddress
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null address results in an empty address string.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry with a null ThingId results in an empty thingId string.

methods.name: logEntryWithMissingThingIdAndAddress
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization/deserialization when address and ThingId are missing, expecting empty values.

methods.name: jsonWithMissingThingIdAndAddress
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON missing address and ThingId fields.

methods.name: verifyBuilder
methods.description: Verifies that the LogEntry builder correctly constructs an immutable LogEntry matching expected.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating a LogEntry from JSON produces the expected LogEntry object.

methods.name: fromJsonWithIllegalDate
methods.description: Ensures that invalid date format in JSON throws JsonParseException.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for ImmutableLogEntry.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableLogEntry and related classes are immutable.
